title: Realize all-size ordered shears on fourteen fixed tapes
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The selected ordered-stream implementation describes its split/merge routing in Python while leaving host arithmetic, scratch erasure and some head returns outside the payload meter. This supplies a literal finite controller for its ordered unit-shear specialization, with every physical step charged.

For every positive binary-encoded `P,Q,G,S`, with `V=P Q² G S`, the controller maps `(p,x,g,y,z)` to `(p,x,g,(y+x) mod Q,z)`; a second controller implements the inverse. Each has **14 fixed tapes, a seven-symbol alphabet and 531 finite microinstructions**, independent of all runtime extents. A written all-size invariant and exact instruction ledger prove **at most 442V transitions and 41V visited cells**, including descriptor conversion, complete scratch/marker erasure and head restoration. Source and descriptors remain unchanged; the output is separately owned.

This removes the host-control assumption for one precise existing `add_high` specialization: coefficient ±1, zero carry and ordered fields. It is a physical routing construction, not another finite endpoint audit. The underlying split/merge method is inherited. **It does not complete the selected affine routing or recursive caller, discharge H2, or improve κ.** Carries, rational scaling, reversed-field interchange, role allocation and outer transfer remain separate obligations.

Only `research/fixed-tape-ordered-shear/` is added. Start with `README.md` and `PROOF.md`, then `shear.py`; `TABLE.json` contains both complete programs, one instruction per line.

## Task and overlap

Explicit user assignment; refined `uniform-transfer-audit`, priority revision 5. Started from current canonical main `8e22a9d9f621c72ab5b299061c2be4c7f638fd3c`, then rebased onto refreshed main `1696cf14e403b3eab35cd9eab27a4c2eb4e4ae38`; guidance, selected record, runner and consumed source were unchanged. Exact source hashes, task scope and inspected PR heads are recorded in `SOURCES.json` and `TASK.json`.

- [PR #2753](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2753) supplies the logical caller, and [PR #2760](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2760) maps its remaining storage/compiler obligations. This realizes a routing primitive inside that boundary.
- [PR #2635](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2635) supplies matched-packet parking; [PR #2769](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2769) supplies numerical-bank parking. The new [physical-caller lowering claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18958887) covers Frame/BankParking and suspended roles. This payload-permutation kernel is complementary.
- [PR #2636](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2636) implements padding scans; [PR #2235](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2235) supplies broader multitape formalization infrastructure. Neither is imported or duplicated here.
- [PR #2411](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2411) links a separate external Lean multiplication proof. This package makes no first-machine-multiplication claim and does not audit that proof.

The final complete metadata refresh at 21:18 UTC covered 715 open PRs and 1,408 Discussion records without warnings. The search excludes arbitrary diffs and unpublished work; it is not a novelty certificate. No public coordination messages were posted under the narrower user instructions.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fixed-tape-ordered-shear --check-only
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fixed-tape-ordered-shear
```

Both pass on the refreshed base. Evidence includes 98 sparse physical cases; a separate dense interpreter with 164 directional cases, 15 inverse round trips, 30 translated-origin cases and 34 authenticated predecessor comparisons; 1,029 binary-counter cases; six physical mutation controls; and seven optimized-Python boundary/authentication tests. Exact transition and visited-span formulas match every successful execution.

The Git-free export passes all four component commands without changing file hashes. Corrupt tables, either saved receipt and live source bytes are rejected; stale bytecode cannot replace authenticated source. Independent AI implementation/proof reviews agree on the exact cost formula and cleanup contract. Finite execution evidence supports the implementation; the universal result rests on the written proof. No external human review, proof-assistant verification, selected cold replay or hosted-CI pass is claimed.

## Credit

The upstream ordered-affine stream lemma and Jose Manuel's selected stream reduction supply the method and interface. The logical-caller, parking and parallel lowering contributions retain separate credit. Prepared for David Arias with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including independent implementation and checking agents. New work is Apache-2.0; frozen sources and the selected frontier are unchanged.

## Open next questions

Extend this explicit physical contract to one fixed-carry or rational-scaling kernel; then bind it to the active physical caller's named role/alias interface when available. `TASK.json` and `README.md` give the concrete first steps and blockers. A unit shear and parked banks alone do not establish the H2 recurrence.
